protocol: Three diagnostic series, six genuine HTTP mutations each; no concurrent writers. Same full rights fixture. Client-side PG timing includes transfer/decoding but excludes later Drizzle mapping; gaps include framework and instrumentation. track_functions=all; force deferred content_access_commit before COMMIT to expose reconciliation and pg_stat_xact_user_functions. These instrumented latencies are not qualification samples. EXPLAIN ANALYZE uses captured statements inside a rolled-back transaction; the role fixture is restored with its 100 grants before each sample and plan. No parameter values or credentials in output.

INSERT INTO auth_buckets(key,count,started_at,touched_at)
    VALUES($1,1,clock_timestamp(),clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET
    count=CASE WHEN auth_buckets.started_at+$2*interval '1 second'<=clock_timestamp() THEN 1 ELSE least(auth_buckets.count+1,$3) END,
    started_at=CASE WHEN auth_buckets.started_at+$4*interval '1 second'<=clock_timestamp() THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE auth_buckets.started_at END,
    touched_at=clock_timestamp()
    RETURNING count, greatest(1,ceil(extract(epoch FROM started_at+$5*interval '1 second'-clock_timestamp()))) AS retry

    WHERE m.user_id=$1::uuid AND m.workspace_id=$2::uuid
